scope: 17 distinct primary-study DOIs covered by curated source audits. This is an umbrella source-audit count, not 17 core-eligible or mutually independent studies, and not 150 completed full-text eligibility screens. The separate 150-record access audit concerns retrieval/metadata status.
counting_policy: Deduplicate the six source-audit ledgers by case-insensitive primary-paper DOI. Supplements, datasets, correction DOI, dependent coefficients, outcomes, sites and recording intervals do not add studies.
study_id_policy: Existing audit IDs are preserved. Schnytzer2018 and Santini2019 use the original extraction-manifest labels; PAN_CAPUCHIN_2023 uses the existing v132 source ID.

category_definitions.signed_tide_by_diel_coefficient: Reported signed tide-by-diel model coefficient with reported SE; exposure/outcome compatibility and dependence still require assessment.
category_definitions.derivable_correlated_contrasts: Signed tide-by-diel point contrast can be derived from correlated published contrasts; covariance limitations prevent treating it as an exact independent estimate with SE.
category_definitions.omnibus_tide_by_diel_test: Published tide-by-diel omnibus test; no recoverable compatible signed contrast with sampling uncertainty.
category_definitions.other_scale_or_no_recoverable_interactio: Other temporal/exposure scale, marginal/tide-only/diel-only evidence, unverified numerical source, or no recoverable compatible tide-by-diel interaction.

provenance_policy.ledger_locations: Paths are relative to repository root; json_pointer is an exact RFC 6901 pointer, with empty string denoting the document root.
provenance_policy.hashes: SHA-256 values were recomputed from acquired original primary, related-thesis, supplement, archive or original-data bytes. Extracted text, rendered images, local notes and repository metadata are not represented as primary/data hashes.
provenance_policy.unknown_provenance: Null SHA-256/bytes means no complete acquired original asset was verified here. Null URL means the acquisition/file URL was not recorded; the study primary URL and ledger assessment remain available. A hash verifies the local bytes and recorded correspondence, not an independent authenticity guarantee.
provenance_policy.supplement_hashes: Schnytzer supplement receipt hashes are MD5; original local members were checked against those MD5 values and SHA-256 was computed separately.
provenance_policy.partial_data: A partial header check does not establish a complete-file SHA-256, usable record count or analysis readiness.

studies.region: Tagus estuary and Ria Formosa, Portugal

quantitative_evidence.assessment: Ria Formosa conditional day/night log-odds contrasts permit a signed low-versus-high-tide difference. Cross-contrast covariance and an exact interaction SE are unavailable; the derived bounds are sensitivity envelopes, not a reported CI. Tagus feeding uses an additive model; preening retains diel only, while the exact roosting model/averaging provenance remains unresolved and excluded from harmonization. Tables S7/S8 contain 174 dependent behavior contrasts, including ambiguous printed labels.

studies.independent_unit: 35 analyzed juvenile birds: 10 Tagus and 25 Ria Formosa; one study with two wetland contexts. Repeated fixes, behaviors and contrasts are not independent animals or studies.

raw_access.details: Original timestamp/activity records stated available from the corresponding author on reasonable request; no author contact or raw-data acquisition. Published supplement and effort table acquired.

quantitative_evidence.assessment: Habitat-selection coefficients within separate seasonal, diel and daytime tidal strata are not a joint tide-by-diel activity contrast. Exact compatible coefficient plus SE not extracted.

studies.independent_unit: 20 tagged birds, 19 annual tracks, 18 in habitat selection; four nested regions of one regional study. Repeated used/available shore points are not independent birds or studies.

raw_access.details: Movebank study 696824680 is cited by the paper; unauthenticated metadata retrieval returned HTTP 401. Original tracks were not retrieved.

studies.region: Humble Island / Palmer Deep, western Antarctic Peninsula

quantitative_evidence.assessment: Weekly one-high-tide versus two-high-tides-per-day regimes and daily tidal-amplitude tests concern foraging distance. No solar-diel predictor or compatible tide-by-solar-diel interaction is reported.

studies.independent_unit: One colony across 10 seasons; 11 dive-recorded birds in 2011. Historical unique-animal count is unresolved: methods report 103 birds, annual entries sum to 113 bird-seasons. Trips and fixes are dependent.

raw_access.details: No original timestamp data repository verified; only supporting track image S1 linked in article.

studies.region: San Lorenzo colony, Peninsula Valdes, Argentina

quantitative_evidence.assessment: Published current-direction occupancy and behavior summaries do not supply a tide-by-solar-diel activity effect. The data lead supports a possible new analysis, not an estimated interaction in this audit.

studies.independent_unit: 27 birds, one colony, one trip per bird; repeated 1 Hz observations and shared currents are dependent.

raw_access.details: Figshare metadata and an HTTP 206 byte-range header/first rows of Penguins.csv were checked. Full observation/current files were not acquired or analyzed; total usable records and per-bird coverage remain unverified.

studies.region: Northern Indian River Lagoon, Florida, USA

quantitative_evidence.assessment: Table 3 supplies an exact tide-only negative-binomial slope and SE. Surveys occur at the highest daytime tide; no night effort or identified tide-by-diel interaction. A shoreline-offset discrepancy remains unresolved.

studies.independent_unit: Two fixed shorelines within one northern Indian River Lagoon coast; daily surveys, not independent coast replicates. Individual crabs were not identified; 173 site-survey rows, including 108 zeros, are repeated surveys.

raw_access.details: Publisher S1 CSV acquired and audited: 173 rows at two sites. No night effort; Kelly Park CpM implies a different shoreline length from the article. This prevents a new tide-by-diel analysis.

studies.taxon: Unidentified mixed fish assemblage; individuals tracked acoustically, species not separable

quantitative_evidence.assessment: Wavelet and seasonal tide/diel patterns provide no common signed conditional coefficient with sampling variance. Original gap-fill flags, schema, and exposure are unverified.

studies.independent_unit: One bottom-mounted acoustic site, one independent coast; two years do not create two studies. Hourly counts are repeated temporal samples; individual fish and species are not identified across the series.

raw_access.details: Dryad CSV/README were not acquired: public download returned HTTP 403/Anubis and whole-dataset API returned HTTP 401. Published harmonic gap fills cannot be treated as original observations.

quantitative_evidence.assessment: Tide-only foraging-probability ratio is approximate and lacks a contrast SE. Tide height-by-change is retained; hour is removed by selection, which is not an estimated zero interaction. Tide-conditioned HMM states cannot independently validate tide predictiveness.

studies.independent_unit: 18 tagged adults; Table 1 contains 13 analyzed crabs, one creek/estuary coast; repeated 15-min positions/acceleration.

raw_access.details: IMOS CEFT raw repository declared; author repository contains code without required processed animal/environment inputs. Supplement not acquired.

studies.region: St. John Baptist Bay, southeast Alaska, USA

quantitative_evidence.assessment: Table 2 reports marginal diel/tidal means with SE derived from printed twice-SE margins. Table 3 has conditional main-effect coefficients without SE/covariance. Shared-fish marginals do not recover a crossed tide-by-diel interaction.

studies.independent_unit: 13 tagged, six analyzed; one bay; two receivers do not create independent coasts. Ten-minute intervals are repeated observations within fish.

raw_access.details: No verified open original telemetry files or coefficient covariance matrix located in the source audit.

studies.region: Estero Luisico creeks, Bahia Malaga, Colombia

quantitative_evidence.assessment: Abstract-level spring/neap-by-day/night patterns concern a fortnightly tidal-amplitude scale. Supporting-information metadata was inspected; numeric model contrasts and uncertainty were not verified.

studies.independent_unit: Four Estero Luisico mangrove creeks in one Bahía Málaga coastal system; one-year 2009–2010 sampling. Individual independence and tide/diel cell denominators are not established from the inspected metadata; stomach totals are not cell counts.

raw_access.details: Publisher advertises AppendixS1 with models and sampling effort; the file was not retrieved and original behavioral data were not verified.

studies.region: Connected Scheldt river-estuary system, Belgium and Netherlands

quantitative_evidence.assessment: Conditional acceleration means and CIs are correlated model predictions without prediction covariance. Final tidal-zone model retains tidal phase only; dropped circadian terms are not a precise null interaction. The study is not wholly outside the Netherlands.

studies.independent_unit: 34 tagged; 33 detected/analyzed; six accelerometer tags. One connected river-estuary/coast crossing national boundary; 90,107 detections are repeated observations.

raw_access.details: European Tracking Network MICHIMIT metadata and DOI verified; original raw files were not acquired.

studies.region: Big Qualicum Estuary, Strait of Georgia, British Columbia, Canada

quantitative_evidence.assessment: Table 2A reports signed tide-by-diel coefficients with SE, including tide-by-night. Tide is standardized separately within diel periods; physical exposure harmonization is required before comparison with high/low contrasts. Coefficients and release-period interactions are correlated; covariance is unavailable. Preserve the ambiguous printed interval-level label.

studies.independent_unit: seal; 7 seals in Table2A/B; one estuary and study. Twenty tagged and 17 complete records do not replace the modeled seven-seal denominator; repeated hours and coefficients are not independent units.

raw_access.details: Main article and original supplement acquired. Supplement contains methods/models/predictions, not original observations; raw animal data and coefficient covariance were not located.

quantitative_evidence.assessment: Tide-by-diel was tested but not retained; no signed contrast/SE is recoverable. Diel-by-season and separate tidal smooth statistics do not supply a tide-by-diel contrast. Do not encode model selection as effect zero.

studies.independent_unit: One population/coast, 3 sites; individuals unknown and may occur across sites. Hours and sites are dependent study samples, not independent studies.

raw_access.details: Dryad processed GAMM table and README identified; both public file clicks returned HTTP 403. No original bytes acquired and no raw refit performed.

quantitative_evidence.assessment: Unconditional day/night movement means and SDs are available, but no tidal predictor or tide-conditioned contrast. Paired covariance and the explicitly confirmed diel-test denominator are unavailable.

studies.independent_unit: 20 tagged adults in two overlapping cohorts; 18 moving crabs, with diel-test n not explicitly restated. Repeated movements and pair-bonded animals are dependent; one bay.

raw_access.details: Article Table 2 gives per-crab totals; supplements are photographs. No complete dated detection/transition records, tide series, or individual day/night cells located.

quantitative_evidence.assessment: Tables 2-5 report four 12-df tide-by-diel F tests on correlated acoustic outcomes. No sign, compatible conditional day/night contrast, complete crossed cell means, or contrast covariance is recoverable.

studies.independent_unit: One acoustic station and unidentified dolphins; 16,759 ten-minute bins across 127 days are repeated temporal samples, not independent animals. Four outcomes share the same series.

raw_access.details: Availability statement points to the article; zero supplementary-material records in inspected XML. Time-indexed raw bins and covariates were not located.

quantitative_evidence.assessment: Field day/night bout-duration U test lacks effect moments and a tide-conditioned contrast. Laboratory rhythm periods/proportions and gene-expression results are different outcomes; they do not recover the requested activity interaction.

studies.independent_unit: One field boulder population; visible-limpet fractions have a changing denominator, without longitudinal individual identification. Bout samples and sequential laboratory phases do not establish independent tide-by-diel groups.

raw_access.details: Main XML and four supplements acquired; those supplements contain figures/tables and transcript/pathway data, not a locomotor bout series. Transcriptome/sequence accessions are not behavioral raw data.

studies.region: Raglan Pier, Port Erin, Isle of Man

quantitative_evidence.assessment: Figure 3 reports marginal emerged-time and nocturnal-time allocations; no joint tide-by-night activity cells or covariance. Table 2 interaction is substratum-by-shore-height, not tide-by-diel.

studies.independent_unit: 60 analyzed limpets, 15 per substrate-by-height cell, at one pier; different individuals across three recording periods. Five-minute observations are repeated within animal.

raw_access.details: Inspected primary PDF contains no identified behavioral raw-data accession or availability statement. Joint per-individual tide/day-night effort and activity records would be needed.

studies.region: Jicaron Island, Panama, Eastern Tropical Pacific

quantitative_evidence.assessment: Original models separate tide/distance and hour/distance. Authentic data do not provide an identified unconditional activity-rate interaction: every archived sequence is conditioned on a capuchin detection, with no confirmed effort intervals/zeros. Group size given detection is not activity rate.

studies.independent_unit: One study and island/coast; 104 camera locations and 22,185 positive sequences are dependent sampling records, not independent animals. Unique independent-animal count is unknown.

raw_access.details: Zenodo archive and CSV verified. Nominal deployment endpoints exist, but confirmed uptime/gaps and opportunity intervals/zeros do not; tide is precomputed from a station approximately 90 km away. No behavioral raw-data fit performed.
